title: I Broke the New Dragonwilds Raid | Kuldra Guide + Tricks
author: CrossRSDW
description:
PATCHED: The load zone extraction skip has been patched as of 9/25, and no longer works. The rest of this guide, including skips, tips and tricks still work and are useful. If anything else changes, I’ll let you know. 

The Kuldra raid is out alongside the RuneScape: Dragonwilds 1.0 launch. This guide provides helpful tips, tricks and skips to help you with your first or fiftieth clear.

I'm CrossRSDW, and I spent time stress-testing the raid so you don't have to. I've found cheese, tricks, and skips that will speed up your farming runs.

Hope to see you in Ashenfall o7

transcript.text: Currently, you can skip almost the entire new raid. Once you've completed it, you can skip pretty much all the way
to the very end. I will show you that because it's definitely going to get patched. There's no way it does not get
patched. First, it's important to note that you have to actually play through the raid one time. I have been stress
testing the raid looking for methods for skipping the mechanics and I found several. Uh but we're going to do a
quick run-through and I'll show you some of the highlights that save a lot of time. After that, I'll show you how to
skip some of the cauldron mechanics and then the end of the video is showing how to trigger each of the load zones for
scumming. Timestamps will be at the bottom. You can jump to whichever one you want to see. I hope I'm not getting
trouble for talking about this. Yeah, I don't care. Really quick raid prep guide. Have all three combat styles, a
panic food of some kind, bring some tea, food, and some water, and the best armor set that you have. Drop a loadstone at
Zilyana's feet. It will save you a lot of time. The first major skip is immediately after the first black dragon
after you walk through the earth door. Hug the castle on the right-hand side. Wind step your way around to the back of
the castle. This allows you to jump past the wind barrier designed to keep you from cheesing this down to the next
zone. This skipping the entire floating island with the zombies and the skeletons and the necromancer.
The first urn is located right behind the black dragon in Fragments of Gornavel. It's very easy to get it. All
you do is run up. You grab the earth buff. You run further back behind where the black dragon is. You dunk it in the
pillar there. And then up the stairs and the urn is right there. For the jump puzzle,
you can skip almost the entire jump puzzle. Make your way down the easy easy path. You can actually jump up on the
side of this bridge and then wind step up onto the top. Alternatively, you can just wind step across from the poison at
the top. From here, you just run over towards where the skeletons and the necromancer are. I highly recommend
killing that necromancer right now because he can spawn skeletons on the red platform, make your day a living
hell. Once we've killed him and then jumped over to that red platform, if you look on the left here, you're going to
see an outcropping. That's going to be kind of where we're targeting, just to kind of give you an idea. Right behind
that, there is geometry sticking out of the wall that you can stand on. And then right behind that is the
location we're needing to go. So, what we're going to do is first cast wind step and then cast recall so that you
have the safety net of falling back to the red platform if you happen to fall. Jump straight forward towards that dark
outcropping just past it on the right. It's very important, turn your entire body towards the wall and start walking
towards the wall midair because that's going to slow your momentum down enough by the time you hit that geometry,
you'll catch. And then from there, it's a very easy double jump, wind dash and you are there at the abyssal demon.
Congratulations, you just skipped the entire jump puzzle. For the second urn, if you don't already have it, it's
located on this platform, but we're going to need to activate a lever in order to open the door. You're going to
jump down and you're going to roll out and then we're going to go through the vines
up the elevator and then that first lever right in front of you is going to be the one that opens
the door to the urn. So, then it's very quickly we run out and around pulling levers on the way.
Past the rats. And then we jump over to where the urn is located.
And then from there, it's just very quickly back up. You can actually run past the abyssal demon and you can get
the checkpoint up on the hill behind the abyssal demon so that if you do die to it, you can just go back and fight it.
You don't have to go skip the entire jump puzzle again. You can actually teleport away and then the abyssal demon
will drop aggro and then you can teleport back. There's actually a huge cheese for this zone as well.
After you've walked through the water door, hug the fortress wall on the right-hand side.
You're going to wind step your way to the back. And this allows us to wind step our way
up into this window, thus cheesing the door mechanic. Kill the minion on the inside to collect the air buff,
and dunk the air buff. Hit the lever, grab the orb, dunk the orb.
But we're not done cheesing. We're going to cheese our way to the fire buff as well. If you hug the geometry on the
right-hand side over here, we wind step our way behind the fortress, and then up through this
window in order to collect the fire buff. This allows us to skip multiple other door mechanics. Out through the
top, dunk the fire buff, and you are done with this zone. The third urn, actually a lot easier
than people think. What you would normally do is turn both water valves, and this causes three platforms to
extend and retract. You can divert the water after the platforms are extended, and they will remain extended. Grab the
third urn. Do this, save yourself the headache. You're welcome. Okay, now we're going to talk about the Cauldron
tips and tricks and cheese. Do the first platform totally normal. I don't really
have any cheese for that. I always start by grabbing the earth crystal on the left-hand side before the dragon spawns
in. Go dunk it. We're going to need that orb anyway. And then by the time you've dunked it, the blue dragon will have
spawned. Kill it, grab the blue buff, grab the orb, and then run over to the blue pillar and dunk the blue buff. And
then you just do your three shots on Cauldron. Do that again, kill the blue dragon, dunk the buff, grab the orb,
shoot Cauldron. Easy peasy. If you already have a dragon weapon, you'll deal an additional couple thousand
damage to the boss. Don't know why. It doesn't do a ton for you, but it will skip an additional shot
at least by the second platform. Another pro tip is you are technically invulnerable while you're attached to
the cannon, so you can time that to avoid damage from big attacks. At this point, Zilyana will teleport you to the
next zone. On occasion, it will spawn two red dragons for you. If it does this, that's great. It actually saves
you some time. Kill one red dragon, immediately dump the buff in the pillar to your right, kill the second red
dragon and dunk it in the orb generator. You're always going to wait for that first red dragon. Kill it as quickly as
possible, dunk it in that pillar. If only one red dragon has spawned, immediately run to the wind totem right
there. Do not be lollygagging in this zone. That is where Koldra starts her dragon breath. It will triple stack you
even if you're in the middle of eating. You are safe if you're standing on the little platform in the back with the
winds. You're going to grab the wind buff from there. At this point, the red dragon should have respawned. Take the
wind buff, dunk it in the orb generator. Kill the red dragon, go ahead and dump that into the orb generator as well.
Grab the initial orb, go dunk the orb in the pillar on your way to re-grab the air buff. Once we have the air buff,
next red dragon should have spawned. Dump the air buff, kill the next red dragon, dump that buff, grab the orb,
shoot Koldra. Grab your second orb, head back over, shoot Koldra again. Zilyana will then appear, hide within Zilyana's
shield, and she will teleport you to phase three. I recommend avoiding at all costs the electricity attacks on the
ground. Because if they happen to catch you as you're trying to jump across, they'll
take away all of your stamina and you'll fall to your demise. So, run as quick as
you can and you should be able to avoid them. Avoid this zone over here. That's where Koldra starts her breath attack.
Just don't be lollygagging. It's always going to spawn a blue dragon first. Sometimes it will double spawn a blue
dragons. That messes us up and and just takes longer. It tricks the game into thinking that two dragons have already
been killed, and instead of spawning a red dragon, it'll spawn a third blue dragon. So, after you kill the first
blue dragon, go dump the blue dragon's buff for an animosphere. By then, the red dragon will have spawned. Go kill
it. This is where we have the only major cheese of the cultist fight. We actually do not need to open this door. We can
bypass it and jump over it. With the red buff in hand, jump down, dunk it into the pillar, and the cannon is now online.
We jump back. And now, from here, there should be another blue dragon. Go ahead and kill it. Go get another anima orb
from it, and grab your previous anima orb. Jump back, load the cannon, start shooting. You have another anima orb
waiting for you. You're just going to go back, grab that, and then those are your
other three shots, and you're done. All right, when you're doing cultist heart, if you look to the left here, you'll see
a vine, and then a rib cage. If you stand just in front of the vine, but behind the rib cage, you can start to
deal damage to it with something like magic or ranged. And as long as the little health bar does not appear at the
top, you are not technically in combat, and it will not target you with any AoE attacks. That will save you some
seconds. And then, run back out once the heart's dead, and you're done. All right, so now the cheese that
everybody's waiting for. After you've completed the raid one time, you can then load zone scum your way to the end
of the raid in just a couple of minutes. I'm going to show you how to do it. So, for zone one, you're going to walk
straight forward towards the the wind pillar on the left, and as you approach it, the next zone at
the top will trigger. You can see it with the text up here at the top. Whenever that text appears, it has
worked, and you have loaded the next extraction zone. So, what we can do then is pause the
game, or just open up your main menu, and then hold to unstuck, which will send you back to the chapel. From here,
we can just teleport back to the Xil'yana lodestone, talk to Xil'yana. You can see that the second zone is
available for teleport, so we teleport there. For this zone, we're going to run towards the door in the keep that is
both fire and air. So, we just hug the left wall here through this gate up here towards the staircase, and you will see
it trigger at the top. For this one, you can also hold the unstuck and then teleport back to Zilyana. This next one
is comically easy. As soon as you teleport in, we're going to walk towards the blue crystal. As you approach it,
you will get the next zone. I hold the unstuck here. It's faster to just turn around, walk back onto the portal,
and teleport straight back to Zilyana. For our fourth one, this was the most difficult one. You just have to do the
platforming from this spawn location all the way to the door there. Once you reach this gateway right here, you'll
see the text spawn in at the top, and you are good to go back. You can hold the unstuck for this one. Now, when we
teleport back to Zilyana, you'll see that the fourth teleport option has changed to Coldarra's Layer,
allowing you to go straight to the boss. Congratulations. You have just teleported your way
through the raid to the very end, and it has taken approximately 3 minutes. This will speed up your grinding. Get it in
while you can. Just do it now. If you're going to do it, do it now, because it's definitely going to get patched. And
that's it. Those are all the tips I have for you. As I close this out, I'm going to showcase some of the rewards. If you
don't want any spoilers, feel free to click away. If you don't mind them, stick around. Thanks for watching. I'll
catch you soon.
The goal is to give Coldarra the D, right? Oh, the D semi.
